messages:
Nora: kicking off canary v2026.04.05-canary -> 12% global, regions=[na-west,eu-central]. Change window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.04.05-canary
DeployBot: deploy started id=cn-176555 target=12% regions=[na-west,eu-central]
Ethan: watching latency and embed throughput. eu-central warmup looks fine at 3m in.
Vera: na-west 95p embeddings jumped 60ms -> 210ms in the first 4m. No 5xxs but tail increased.
SRE-Oncall: flagged. Pulling traces. Suspect adapter cold starts on autoscaled nodes plus kv cache misses.
Nora: ok pause na-west only and keep eu-central. Command: ``/deploy pause cn-176555 --region na-west``
DeployBot: acknowledge: paused cn-176555 for region na-west. rollout => na-west=0%, eu-central=12% -> global~6%
Ethan: confirmed traffic shift. na-west pinned to v2026.04.03-stable.
SRE-Oncall: recommend running quick prewarm + set PREFETCH=1 for na-west. Also suggest a short-lived metric on kv-miss-rate.
Vera: will run quick prewarm. Executing: ``infra/prewarm --region na-west --model canary --fast``
ReleaseManager: adding PREFETCH toggle to the rollout config: ``set FLAG_PREFETCH=1 --region na-west``
DeployBot: prewarm job queued job=pw-176555-nw
Vera: prewarm done. PREFETCH=1 applied. KV hit improved 0.39 -> 0.9.
Ethan: good. propose cautious resume: ramp 2% -> 6% -> 12% with 3m checks.
Nora: agree. Command: ``/deploy resume cn-176555 --region na-west --ramp 2,6,12 --interval 3m``
DeployBot: resuming cn-176555: na-west ramp=2%->6%->12% intervals=3m; eu-central remains 12%
SRE-Oncall: monitoring kv-miss-rate and embedding-95p for na-west. I'll call if any regressions.
Ethan: na-west at 2%: 95p back to 85ms.
Vera: 6% stable, no errors.
Nora: at 12% na-west now. Keeping rollback and pause commands handy: ``/deploy rollback cn-176555`` or ``/deploy pause cn-176555 --region <region>``
ReleaseManager: updating changelog: "canary: PREFETCH=1 + prewarm for na-west to address adapter cold-start tail"
DeployBot: rollout complete cn-176555 -> 12% active. Temporary metrics and flags will auto-expire in 60m.
SRE-Oncall: LGTM. Standing by for the next 60m. :white_check_mark:
